candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; traces and logs show the order service failing with 500 on every checkout attempt, propagating as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and metrics are absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 (db, payment, inventory) is not established.

report.explanation: All four checkout observations are 502 with short durations; traces and logs consistently show the gateway's client call to order /v1/orders returning 500, which the gateway surfaces as 502. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded cause is an order-service HTTP 500 propagating to checkout; the deeper order-internal fault is not observable in current evidence.
